title: Formal-Methods Invariant Monitors: Runtime Assertions on Concept Projections

original_idea.body: Implement a lightweight runtime monitor checking temporal invariants over concept probe values per token; report violation rates. Inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (runtime monitor + violation rates), implementing per-token monitor adds modest workstream (level 4).
